sentences.text:
The Court made the following Order:
Both the petitioners are sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for a period of six (06) months and also sentenced to pay a fine of Rs.1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand Only) each in default of payment of fine.

They shall also ordered to undergo simple imprisonment for further period of one (01) month for the offence punishable under Section 16(1)(a) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act by the learned IV Additional Junior Civil Judge, Guntur.

2. The said order of conviction was confirmed by the learned Special Sessions Judge-Cum-IV Additional District & Sessions Judge, Guntur vide its Order, dated 31.03.2009, in Criminal Appeal No.120 of 2008.

entities.text: Special Sessions Judge-Cum-IV Additional District & Sessions Judge, Guntur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Assailing both the Orders, the instant Criminal Revision has been preferred.
3. This Criminal Revision has been preferred by A3 & A4.

A3 is the Manager-Cum-Director of A4.
4.
During the pendency of the instant Criminal Revision, a Report was called for regarding the status of the petitioners.
The Inspector of Police, Adoni II Town Police Station, has placed a Report.

In the Report, it appears that the petitioner No.1 (A3)
namely Sri Lohar Mukthair Ahmmed was expired on 20.05.2021.
5.
The petitioner No.1/A3 being the Director of the private limited company and petitioner No.2/A4 being the juristic person i.e., a company, is not required to proceed further with this matter.
SS,J 6.
Accordingly, nothing left for this Court to decide the instant Criminal Revision and thus, the instant Criminal Revision became infructuous and the same is hereby disposed of.
As a sequel, interlocutory applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
SUBHENDU SAMANTA, J KPV SS,J THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE SUBHENDU SAMANTA CRIMINAL REVISION CASE No:552 of 2009 06.11.2025 KPV L.Mukthar Ahmed Another vs The State Of A.P.
